subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should agent-scoped delivery, Control UI, send, and plugin paths without active sandbox context intentionally reject all sandbox files after upgrade, with only sandbox-aware message-action paths retaining exact-workspace access?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes existing authorization behavior across several callers; tests and helper-level evidence cannot establish whether that fail-closed contract matches the intended product boundary.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
options.body: Accept sandbox access only for callers carrying the authoritative active workspace and require direct caller-level proof before merge.

options.title: Thread additional context
options.body: Identify any other legitimate sandbox-media callers and supply their exact active workspace before merging the broad-root removal.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Accept sandbox access only for callers carrying the authoritative active workspace and require direct caller-level proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the earlier media-root scoping behavior and have the clearest feature-history connection to this authorization contract.
